recipes.title: Crisp Celery & Black Pepper Egg Scramble
recipes.summary: Soft skillet eggs folded with finely diced celery stalk, sweet onion, olive oil, and freshly cracked black pepper.
steps: Finely dice celery stalk and onion so they soften quickly and evenly.
Warm olive oil over medium-low heat and saute celery and onion for 3 minutes until tender-crisp.
Whisk eggs with black pepper, pour into the skillet, and fold gently over low heat until softly set.
Remove from heat while still glossy and finish with chopped parsley.
tips: Run a vegetable peeler down the rounded back of each celery stalk first if you prefer a softer, string-free bite.
Dice the celery and onion the night before and store them in an airtight container for a 5-minute morning breakfast.

recipes.title: Savory Celery, Onion & Soft Egg Oat Bowl
recipes.summary: Warm rolled oats simmered with sauteed celery stalk, tender onion, cracked black pepper, and a soft-cooked egg.
steps: Warm olive oil in a small saucepan over medium-low heat and sweat thinly sliced celery stalk, diced onion, and minced garlic for 3 minutes.
Stir in rolled oats and water or broth, bring to a gentle simmer, and cook 6 minutes until creamy.
Transfer to a warm bowl, season generously with black pepper, and top with a soft-boiled or poached egg.
tips: Using warm low-sodium vegetable broth instead of plain water deepens the savory flavor without extra salt.
Keep soft-boiled eggs pre-cooked in the fridge so you only need to warm the oats.

recipes.title: Lemon Celery & Avocado Whole-Grain Toast
recipes.summary: Creamy mashed avocado topped with crisp diced celery stalk, fresh lemon juice, olive oil, and cracked black pepper.
steps: Toast whole-grain bread until golden and crisp.
Mash ripe avocado in a small bowl with half of the lemon juice until smooth.
Toss finely diced celery stalk with olive oil, the remaining lemon juice, and black pepper.
Spread avocado onto warm toast and spoon the crisp seasoned celery on top.
tips: Finely dicing the celery into tiny cubes keeps every bite balanced and prevents pieces from sliding off the toast.
Save the tender pale inner celery stalks and leafy tips here for extra aroma.

recipes.title: Herbed Celery, Tomato & Cottage Cheese Bowl
recipes.summary: Protein-rich cottage cheese layered with crunchy celery stalk, ripe tomato, black pepper, dill, and olive oil.
steps: Slice celery stalk into thin crescents and dice ripe tomato.
Spoon cottage cheese into a shallow bowl and arrange celery and tomato on top.
Drizzle with olive oil and finish with chopped dill and cracked black pepper.
tips: If you prefer a smoother, creamier base, pulse the cottage cheese in a blender for 15 seconds before topping.
Swap fresh dill for chives or parsley depending on what you already have on hand.

recipes.title: Skillet Celery, Onion & Sweet Potato Hash
recipes.summary: Golden diced sweet potato pan-roasted with celery stalk, sweet onion, bell pepper, garlic, and cracked black pepper.
steps: Dice sweet potato into small even 1/2-inch cubes so they cook quickly without burning.
Warm olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat, add sweet potato, cover, and cook 9 to 10 minutes, stirring once.
Uncover and add sliced celery stalk, diced onion, and bell pepper; cook 5 minutes until tender and lightly browned.
Stir in minced garlic and cracked black pepper for 1 minute until fragrant, then serve warm.
tips: Pre-cubed sweet potato from the produce aisle cuts prep time in half on low-energy mornings.
Leftover hash reheats cleanly in a skillet for up to 3 days and pairs nicely with a fried or soft-cooked egg.

recipes.title: Lemon Celery & Cracked Pepper Chickpea Salad
recipes.summary: Lightly smashed chickpeas folded with crisp celery stalk, finely diced onion, lemon juice, olive oil, and black pepper.
steps: Rinse and drain cooked chickpeas, then lightly mash about half of them with a fork for a creamy binder.
Fold in finely diced celery stalk, minced onion, chopped parsley, olive oil, and fresh lemon juice.
Season generously with cracked black pepper and serve over greens, in a wrap, or on whole-grain toast.
tips: Chilling the salad for 15 minutes lets the lemon and black pepper soak into the mashed chickpeas.
Keeps fresh in a covered container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days for easy lunches.

recipes.title: Crisp Celery, Apple & Walnut Crunch Salad
recipes.summary: Thinly shaved celery stalk and crisp apple tossed with toasted walnuts, lemon vinaigrette, parsley, and black pepper.

ingredient_details.note: cored and thinly sliced or matchsticked

steps: Thinly slice celery stalk on a diagonal and cut cored apple into thin matchsticks.
Whisk fresh lemon juice, olive oil, and cracked black pepper directly in the bottom of a large mixing bowl.
Add celery, apple, chopped parsley, and toasted walnuts, tossing gently right before serving.
tips: Tossing the apple directly in the lemon dressing right away keeps the slices bright and prevents browning.
Include tender pale celery leaves from the center of the bunch as an extra fresh herb.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Celery & Tuna Lettuce Wrap
recipes.summary: Olive-oil tuna tossed with crunchy celery stalk, minced onion, fresh lemon, and black pepper tucked into crisp lettuce leaves.
steps: Flake drained tuna into a medium bowl with finely diced celery stalk and minced onion.
Drizzle with fresh lemon juice and olive oil, add freshly ground black pepper, and toss lightly.
Spoon the tuna salad into crisp washed lettuce cups and serve chilled.
tips: Butter lettuce leaves cup softly and are easy to fold without cracking.
If you prefer a softer meal, serve the tuna mixture over warm cooked quinoa or soft whole-grain bread instead of lettuce.

recipes.title: Quick Celery, Onion & Red Lentil Potage
recipes.summary: Comforting red lentil soup built on a fragrant base of celery stalk, onion, carrot, garlic, turmeric, and black pepper.
steps: Warm olive oil in a soup pot over medium heat and saute diced celery stalk, onion, and carrot for 5 minutes until softened and fragrant.
Stir in minced garlic, ground turmeric, and black pepper for 30 seconds.
Add rinsed red lentils and water or broth, bring to a boil, then lower heat and simmer partially covered for 18 minutes until lentils break down.
Blend partially or completely with an immersion blender if a velvety smooth bowl is preferred.
tips: Red lentils cook quickly without soaking and naturally thicken into a gentle, easy-to-swallow soup.
Freezes well in single-portion jars for up to 2 months; add a splash of water when reheating.

recipes.title: Warm Garlic Celery & White Bean Tartine
recipes.summary: Tender braised celery stalk and white beans warmed with onion, garlic, lemon zest, olive oil, and black pepper over toast.

ingredient_details.item: fresh lemon juice plus a little zest

steps: Warm olive oil in a skillet over medium-low heat and cook thinly sliced celery stalk, diced onion, and garlic for 5 minutes until tender.
Fold in rinsed white beans, 2 tablespoons of water, lemon juice, and black pepper; simmer 5 minutes while lightly crushing a few beans against the pan.
Spoon the warm, saucy beans and celery over toasted whole-grain bread and finish with lemon zest.
tips: Crushing a quarter of the beans creates a creamy sauce that keeps the topping from rolling off the toast.
Skip the toast and serve in a warm bowl with a drizzle of olive oil for an even softer lunch.

recipes.title: Crisp Celery, Onion & Ginger Chicken Stir-Fry
recipes.summary: Fast weeknight stir-fry pairing sliced chicken with crisp-tender celery stalk, onion, fresh ginger, garlic, and black pepper.

ingredient_details.item: boneless skinless chicken breast or thigh

steps: Warm sesame oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and sear bite-sized chicken pieces for 4 to 5 minutes until golden and cooked through, then transfer to a plate.
Add diagonally sliced celery stalk, onion, grated ginger, and minced garlic to the same pan and stir-fry for 3 minutes until crisp-tender.
Return chicken and any juices to the pan with reduced-sodium soy sauce and cracked black pepper, tossing 2 minutes until glossy.
tips: Slicing celery thinly on a sharp diagonal maximizes flavor surface and makes it cook tender in just 3 minutes.
Serve over warm steamed rice or soft rice noodles to catch the ginger-pepper pan sauce.

recipes.title: Braised Celery, Onion & Lemon Baked Cod
recipes.summary: Tender baked cod nestled over softly braised celery stalk, sweet onion, garlic, olive oil, lemon, and black pepper.
equipment: Medium ceramic or glass baking dish
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Toss sliced celery stalk, sweet onion, and garlic with olive oil in a baking dish and roast 10 minutes until softened.
Nestle the cod fillets directly on top of the warm celery bed, squeeze fresh lemon over the fish, and season with black pepper.
Bake 12 to 14 minutes until the cod flakes effortlessly with a fork, then scatter with chopped parsley.
tips: Roasting the celery and onion first ensures they turn meltingly tender right as the delicate fish finishes.
Cod has a very soft, flaky texture — spoon the warm lemony pan juices over each fillet for extra moisture.

recipes.title: Sheet-Pan Celery, Carrot & Thyme Roast Chicken
recipes.summary: One-pan roasted celery stalk, sweet carrots, onion, garlic, and herb-rubbed chicken seasoned with thyme and black pepper.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper.
Toss celery stalk pieces, sliced carrots, onion wedges, and garlic cloves with olive oil, thyme, and black pepper right on the pan.
Nestle chicken pieces evenly among the vegetables in a single layer.
Roast 25 to 28 minutes, turning once halfway, until vegetables are caramelized and chicken reaches 165°F (74°C).
tips: Lining the sheet pan with parchment means almost zero scrubbing after dinner.
Keep vegetables cut to similar thicknesses so everything roasts tender at the same time.

recipes.title: Black Pepper Celery, Onion & Tofu Rice Skillet
recipes.summary: Savory one-skillet rice bowl with crisp celery stalk, browned tofu, sweet onion, bell pepper, garlic, and bold black pepper.
steps: Pat cubed tofu dry and brown in olive oil over medium heat for 6 minutes, turning occasionally until edges are lightly golden.
Add sliced celery stalk, diced onion, bell pepper, and minced garlic, cooking 4 minutes until bright and tender-crisp.
Fold in cooked rice and freshly cracked black pepper, stirring 2 minutes until warmed through.
tips: Day-old chilled rice or a microwaveable brown rice pouch turns this into a genuine 15-minute dinner.
A squeeze of fresh lemon or splash of low-sodium broth wakes up the whole skillet right before serving.

recipes.title: Velvety Roasted Celery, Potato & Onion Soup
recipes.summary: Smooth, easy-to-swallow soup blending sweet celery stalk, tender potato, sauteed onion, garlic, thyme, and black pepper.
steps: Warm olive oil in a soup pot over medium heat and saute chopped celery stalk, onion, garlic, and thyme for 6 minutes until soft.
Add diced potato and water or broth, bring to a gentle boil, then cover and simmer 18 minutes until completely fork-tender.
Blend carefully until silky smooth and velvety, adding a splash of warm water if too thick, and finish with cracked black pepper.
tips: Yukon gold potatoes give this soup a naturally creamy, velvety body with zero heavy cream.
If using a countertop blender, vent the lid slightly and cover with a clean towel so steam can escape safely.

recipes.title: Crisp Celery, Green Apple & Ginger Smoothie
recipes.summary: Bright green blend of chopped celery stalk, crisp apple, spinach, fresh ginger, lemon juice, and chilled water.
steps: Chop celery stalk into 1-inch pieces to cut across fibers before blending.
Place chilled water, spinach, chopped celery, cored apple, grated ginger, and lemon juice into the blender.
Blend on high for 60 seconds until completely smooth with no fibrous strands.
tips: Adding liquid and leafy spinach to the blender first helps the blades pull everything down smoothly.
Cutting celery across the grain into short 1-inch chunks prevents stringy bits in standard blenders.

recipes.title: Hydrating Celery, Pineapple & Mint Smoothie
recipes.summary: Refreshing tropical green smoothie with celery stalk, sweet pineapple, cool cucumber, fresh mint, lime, and coconut water.
steps: Add chilled coconut water, chopped celery stalk, peeled cucumber, and pineapple chunks to the blender.
Toss in fresh mint leaves and freshly squeezed lime juice.
Blend on high until silky smooth and serve immediately over ice if desired.
tips: Frozen pineapple chunks chill the smoothie naturally without watering down the tropical flavor.
Start with fewer mint leaves if you prefer a subtler herbal finish.

recipes.title: Creamy Celery, Avocado & Greek Yogurt Smoothie
recipes.summary: Silky, filling smoothie blending celery stalk, ripe avocado, Greek yogurt, cucumber, lemon, and a drizzle of honey.
steps: Slice celery stalk and peeled cucumber thinly so they puree effortlessly.
Blend cold water, celery, cucumber, avocado, Greek yogurt, lemon juice, and honey on high until thick and silky.
Adjust with an extra splash of water for an easy sip or keep thicker for a spoonable bowl.
tips: The creamy avocado-yogurt blend gives a gentle, smooth consistency that is easy to sip slowly.
Omit the honey and add a pinch of dill if you enjoy savory yogurt drinks.

recipes.title: Celery, Blueberry & Oat Morning Smoothie
recipes.summary: Mild-tasting purple berry smoothie hiding finely chopped celery stalk with blueberries, oats, banana, cinnamon, and almond milk.
steps: Place rolled oats and almond milk in the blender jar and let soak for 2 minutes so the oats soften.
Add finely chopped celery stalk, blueberries, ripe banana, and ground cinnamon.
Blend on high for 60 seconds until velvety with no visible celery strands.
tips: The sweet blueberries and cinnamon completely soften the green taste — great if you are new to celery smoothies.
Swap almond milk for oat milk or dairy milk without changing any other measurements.

recipes.title: Cool Celery, Pear & Spinach Lime Smoothie
recipes.summary: Naturally sweet ripe pear balanced with crisp celery stalk, baby spinach, bright lime, and a hint of fresh ginger.
steps: Core a ripe pear and slice celery stalk into short rounds.
Place chilled water, spinach, pear, celery, lime juice, and grated ginger into the blender.
Puree on high until completely smooth and frosty.
tips: Soft Bartlett or Anjou pears blend noticeably smoother and sweeter than firm under-ripe pears.
Add 3 to 4 ice cubes if you want a colder, thicker afternoon refresher.

recipes.title: Classic Cold-Pressed Celery & Lemon Juice
recipes.summary: Clean, crisp fresh celery stalk juice brightened with fresh lemon; works in a juicer or blended and strained.

ingredient_details.note: only if using a blender instead of a juicer

equipment: Juicer (or blender plus fine-mesh strainer / nut-milk bag)
steps: Wash crisp celery stalks thoroughly and trim the dry white base ends.
Feed celery steadily through a juicer — or chop and blend with a splash of cold water, then strain through a fine mesh.
Stir in freshly squeezed lemon juice and enjoy chilled right away.
tips: Trimming off most of the dark outer leaves keeps the juice crisp and mild rather than bitter.
Best enjoyed fresh; if making ahead, store in a tightly sealed glass jar filled to the top for up to 24 hours.

recipes.title: Crisp Celery, Apple & Cucumber Mint Cooler
recipes.summary: Lightly sweet green juice combining celery stalk, apple, cool cucumber, garden mint, and a splash of lemon.
steps: Rinse celery stalk, apple, cucumber, and mint sprigs, then quarter the apple.
Feed mint between pieces of cucumber, celery, and apple in a juicer (or blend with 1/2 cup water and strain).
Stir in fresh lemon juice and serve cold over ice if desired.
tips: Sandwiching soft mint leaves between crisp cucumber and apple helps your juicer extract maximum herb aroma.
Dilute with a splash of sparkling water for a light, refreshing afternoon spritzer.

recipes.title: Bright Celery, Carrot, Ginger & Black Pepper Tonic
recipes.summary: Vibrant golden-green juice pairing celery stalk, sweet carrot, fresh ginger, turmeric, lemon, and a pinch of black pepper.
steps: Scrub carrots thoroughly and rinse celery stalk and fresh ginger root.
Juice celery, carrots, and ginger (plus fresh turmeric if using), or blend with 1/2 cup water and strain smooth.
Stir in fresh lemon juice, ground turmeric (if using), and a pinch of finely ground black pepper right before serving.
tips: Fresh turmeric can stain porous cutting boards — rinse your knife and board right away or use ground turmeric.
Stir gently before sipping if the juice sits for a few minutes.

recipes.title: Zesty Celery, Pineapple & Lime Refresher
recipes.summary: Sweet-tart juice balancing fresh celery stalk with juicy pineapple, fresh ginger, and bright lime.
steps: Cut celery stalk into juicer-ready lengths and trim fresh pineapple into spears.
Juice celery, pineapple, and ginger together, alternating firmer celery with juicy pineapple.
Squeeze in fresh lime juice, stir well, and serve chilled over ice.
tips: Pre-cut fresh pineapple containers save effort while giving the same sweet, bright flavor.
Alternating celery and pineapple in the chute clears fibrous pulp cleanly.

recipes.title: Ruby Celery, Beet & Green Apple Press
recipes.summary: Earthy-crisp ruby juice blending fresh celery stalk, scrubbed red beet, crisp apple, ginger, and fresh lemon.
equipment: Juicer (or high-speed blender and fine-mesh strainer)
steps: Scrub and quarter raw red beet and apple, and chop celery stalk into lengths.
Alternate feeding beet, celery, apple, and ginger through the juicer for smooth extraction and best yield.
Stir in fresh lemon juice and chill briefly before serving.
tips: Finishing with crisp celery stalks helps flush bright beet juice cleanly through your juicer.
Adding a squeeze of lemon cuts the earthy taste of raw beet and keeps the ruby color vivid.
